# --ci github renders a GitHub Actions workflow: large targets get their own
# jobs, the rest share `default`, and a `ci` job requires them all.
! bit --ci github
stderr '--ci requires a Git repository'

exec git init -q
bit --ci github
cmp stdout workflow.yml

# With a known default branch, only pushes to it trigger the workflow.
exec git add .
exec git -c user.email=test@example.com -c user.name=Test commit -qm base
exec git update-ref refs/remotes/origin/main HEAD
exec git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD refs/remotes/origin/main
bit --ci github
stdout '^  push:\n    branches: \["main"\]\n  pull_request:$'

# Selected targets run in the jobs they belong to.
bit --ci github deploy unit
stdout '^# Generated by `bit --ci github deploy unit`\. Do not edit\.$'
stdout '^      - run: "bit deploy unit"$'
stdout '^    needs: \["default"\]$'

# A post target depends on every target, so one job runs all large targets.
bit --ci github report
stdout '^  bench:\n    name: "bench, image"\n.*\n.*\n.*\n      - run: "bit report"$'
! stdout '^  default:'

# Projects below the repository root run there.
mkdir sub
cp BUILD.bit sub/BUILD.bit
cd sub
bit --ci github
stdout '^      - run: "bit unit"\n        working-directory: "sub"$'
stdout 'Generated by `bit --ci github`'

! bit --ci github -P x=1
stderr '--ci does not accept -P'

! bit --ci nosuch
stderr 'unknown CI template ''nosuch'''

-- BUILD.bit --
pre setup = exec { command = "true" }

lib = exec { command = "true" }

app = exec {
  command = "true"
  depends_on = [lib]
}

unit = exec.test {
  command = "true"
  depends_on = [app]
}

large image = exec {
  command = "true"
  depends_on = [app]
}

large bench = exec.test {
  command = "true"
  depends_on = [lib]
}

smoke = exec.test {
  command = "true"
  depends_on = [image]
}

explicit deploy = exec { command = "true" }

post report = exec { command = "true" }

group default = [unit, smoke, bench]
-- workflow.yml --
# Generated by `bit --ci github`. Do not edit.
name: bit
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  default:
    name: "default"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - run: "bit unit"
  bench:
    name: "bench"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - run: "bit bench"
  image:
    name: "image"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - run: "bit smoke"
  ci:
    name: "ci"
    if: always()
    needs: ["default","bench","image"]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - if: contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') || contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled') || contains(needs.*.result, 'skipped')
        run: exit 1
